intro: Spicy Lamb Meatballs are a premium protein option on the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) that brings bold Mediterranean flavors to your bowl or pita. These expertly seasoned lamb meatballs deliver 24g of protein per serving with a spicy kick that elevates any customized meal. Whether building your own creation or upgrading a [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) selection, these meatballs add rich, savory depth.
priceCalories: Priced at an additional $2.25 to $2.75 depending on portion size, Spicy Lamb Meatballs contain 300 calories per serving. This protein-packed option provides excellent nutritional value with 24g of protein, 21g of fat, and just 3g of carbs. The premium pricing reflects the quality lamb and authentic Mediterranean spicing that makes this main stand out on the [full CAVA menu](/). A satisfying choice for protein-focused diners.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets these meatballs apart is the authentic blend of Mediterranean spices combined with high-quality lamb. Unlike conventional meatballs, CAVA uses traditional seasonings that deliver genuine heat and complexity. The wheat breadcrumbs provide perfect texture while keeping the meatballs tender and juicy. This premium protein option offers restaurant-quality taste in a fast-casual format, making it a standout choice among [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) selections.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Spicy Lamb Meatballs delivers an impressive nutritional profile with 300 calories, 24g of protein, 21g of fat, and only 3g of carbs. The high protein content supports muscle maintenance and satiety, while the low carb count makes it suitable for various dietary approaches. The fat content comes primarily from the lamb itself, providing essential nutrients and flavor. This macro balance makes it ideal for keto and low-carb dieters.
whatsInside: Spicy Lamb Meatballs feature premium ground lamb seasoned with a proprietary blend of Mediterranean spices that deliver authentic heat and flavor. Wheat breadcrumbs are incorporated to maintain moisture and create the perfect tender texture. The spice blend typically includes paprika, cumin, and chili peppers for that signature kick. Each meatball is carefully crafted to ensure consistent quality and taste throughout your meal at any [CAVA Locations](/locations).
tasteLike: These meatballs deliver a bold, spicy flavor profile with layers of Mediterranean warmth. The lamb provides a rich, slightly gamey taste that is more complex than beef or chicken. Expect genuine heat that builds gradually, balanced by aromatic spices like cumin and coriander. The texture is tender and juicy with a slight crispness on the exterior. The spice level is noticeable but not overwhelming, adding exciting depth to every bite.
customize: Pair Spicy Lamb Meatballs with cooling options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/dips-spreads) like Tzatziki or Hummus to balance the heat. Choose a base from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) such as SuperGreens or Basmati Rice to complement the rich lamb flavor. Add fresh [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) like cucumber, tomatoes, and pickled onions for texture contrast. Finish with a creamy dressing to create perfect flavor harmony.
pairsWell: These spicy meatballs pair exceptionally well with cooling Tzatziki sauce, which tempers the heat while adding creamy tang. SuperGreens or Basmati Rice provide excellent bases that absorb the flavorful juices. Fresh cucumber, tomato, and red onion add crisp contrast to the rich lamb. Consider adding Harissa for extra heat or Lemon Herb Tahini from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) for brightness. Pita chips from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) complete the experience.
healthyChoice: With 24g of protein and only 3g of carbs, Spicy Lamb Meatballs are an excellent choice for high-protein, low-carb diets including keto and paleo approaches. Lamb provides essential nutrients like vitamin B12, zinc, and iron that support overall health. The protein content promotes satiety and muscle maintenance. While the fat content is moderate at 21g, it comes from natural sources. Use the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track complete meal macros.
howToOrder: Select Spicy Lamb Meatballs as your protein when building a custom bowl or pita at CAVA. The upcharge of $2.25 to $2.75 applies based on your portion size preference. You can add them to any [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) creation or build from scratch. Simply inform the team member during the protein selection step. The meatballs come pre-portioned and are served warm atop your chosen base.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Grilled Chicken at 250 calories with no upcharge, Spicy Lamb Meatballs offer richer flavor and more fat at 300 calories for an additional $2.25-$2.75. Harissa Honey Chicken provides 260 calories with a $0.50 upcharge and sweeter heat profile. Grilled Steak has fewer calories at 170 but similar pricing at $2.50-$3.25. Braised Lamb at 210 calories offers tender lamb without the spicy kick at comparable premium pricing.
whoShouldTry: Spicy Lamb Meatballs are perfect for adventurous eaters seeking bold Mediterranean flavors beyond standard chicken options. High-protein dieters will appreciate the impressive 24g protein content. Those following keto or low-carb lifestyles benefit from the minimal 3g carbs. Lamb enthusiasts who enjoy gamey, rich meat flavors should definitely try this premium option. Anyone wanting restaurant-quality protein at fast-casual convenience will find excellent value here despite the upcharge.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying for anyone seeking premium protein with authentic Mediterranean character. The $2.25-$2.75 upcharge delivers restaurant-quality spiced lamb that stands apart from standard fast-casual proteins. With 24g of protein and bold, complex flavors, these meatballs transform an ordinary bowl into a memorable meal. The spice level adds excitement without overwhelming, and the tender texture showcases quality preparation. A must-try for lamb lovers and spice enthusiasts alike.

faqs.q: How spicy are CAVA Spicy Lamb Meatballs?
faqs.a: The Spicy Lamb Meatballs have a noticeable but moderate heat level that builds gradually. The spice comes from Mediterranean chili peppers and paprika rather than overwhelming heat. Most diners find them flavorful and warming rather than intensely spicy. You can balance the heat with cooling toppings like Tzatziki or cucumber for a more mild experience.

faqs.q: How much extra do Spicy Lamb Meatballs cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: Spicy Lamb Meatballs cost an additional $2.25 to $2.75 depending on your portion size and location. This premium upcharge reflects the quality lamb and authentic Mediterranean spicing. Compared to base proteins like Grilled Chicken which have no upcharge, the lamb meatballs are priced similarly to other premium options like Grilled Steak and Braised Lamb.

faqs.q: Are CAVA Spicy Lamb Meatballs gluten-free?
faqs.a: No, Spicy Lamb Meatballs contain wheat breadcrumbs and are not gluten-free. If you need gluten-free options, consider proteins like Grilled Chicken, Grilled Steak, or Braised Lamb instead. Check the CAVA Gluten Free Menu or CAVA Allergen Menu for complete dietary information and safe alternatives that meet your dietary restrictions.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Spicy Lamb Meatballs?
faqs.a: Spicy Lamb Meatballs contain 300 calories per serving with 24g of protein, 21g of fat, and 3g of carbs. This makes them a protein-rich, low-carb option ideal for various dietary approaches. The calorie count is moderate compared to other mains, and the high protein content provides excellent satiety and nutritional value for the premium upcharge.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Spicy Lamb Meatballs?
faqs.a: The meatballs are made with spiced ground lamb and wheat breadcrumbs. The spice blend includes Mediterranean seasonings like cumin, paprika, and chili peppers that create the signature spicy flavor profile. The wheat breadcrumbs help maintain moisture and create a tender texture. The exact proprietary spice blend gives these meatballs their distinctive authentic Mediterranean taste.
